content.name: Potion of Speed
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell haste} spell for 1 minute (no {@status concentration} required). The potion's yellow fluid is streaked with black and swirls on its own.

content.name: Potion of Speed
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Haste|SRD52} spell for 1 minute (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required) without suffering the wave of lethargy that typically occurs when the effect ends.
This potion's yellow fluid is streaked with black and swirls on its own.
